_comment: Source list for the org-news-digest pipeline. Each entry is treated as an RSS/Atom feed.
_verified_note: Set 'verified': false on feeds you haven't confirmed work yet. The pipeline will still attempt them and warn on failure.

sources.name: AARP Press Room
sources.notes: BROKEN: press.aarp.org/rss redirects to HTML, not a feed. AARP does not expose a working press release RSS. No alternative found. Monitor aarp.org/press/releases manually or find an email-to-RSS bridge.

sources.name: AARP on PR Newswire
sources.notes: BROKEN for our purposes: PR Newswire keyword search for 'aarp' returns any release mentioning AARP (pet food, banking, real estate awards, etc.) — not AARP's own releases. All 20 items were junk and were dropped by Claude. Disabled until a cleaner source is found.

sources.name: National Institute on Aging (NIA)
sources.notes: BROKEN: NIA migrated to Drupal 11 and does not expose any RSS feeds. All standard feed paths return empty. No working alternative found. Content is active at nia.nih.gov/news/news-releases but not machine-readable.

sources.name: NIMH News
sources.notes: BROKEN: NIMH (Drupal 10) does not expose a working RSS feed. All tested paths return empty. Content is active at nimh.nih.gov/news but not machine-readable.

sources.name: Alzheimers.gov News
sources.notes: BROKEN: No RSS feed exists. News page is active at alzheimers.gov/news but no feed link in page source. Managed by NIA — content substantially overlaps with NIA news.

sources.name: VA Press Releases
sources.notes: Confirmed working. Returns application/rss+xml. Active with 12+ recent entries including suicide prevention report, dental care access, survivor benefits.

sources.name: NLM / PubMed Updates
sources.notes: Official NLM Technical Bulletin RSS for PubMed news. Confirmed active.

sources.name: CDC Newsroom
sources.org: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.notes: CDC newsroom releases and statements. Confirmed working 2026-09-14 (50 entries, newest 2026-09-10). Agency-wide, so the digest prompt filters for aging relevance. Item links are tools.cdc.gov download URLs that 301-redirect to the cdc.gov/media/releases page. The larger tools.cdc.gov/api/v2/resources/media/132608.rss feed has the same items going back years, with the same redirect links.

sources.name: Department of Labor News Releases
sources.notes: Confirmed working 2026-09-14 (10 most recent releases). Relevant items: home care and direct care worker rules, older workers, retirement plans.

sources.name: HHS News Releases
sources.org: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
sources.notes: UNVERIFIED: returned an Akamai 'Access Denied' (403) on 2026-09-14 to every request from a local test machine, including browser user agents. Left enabled in case GitHub Actions runners get through; check the run log for a warning. GovDelivery bulletins (USHHS) also rejected requests.

sources.name: CMS Newsroom
sources.notes: Confirmed working 2026-09-14. The feed is malformed: titles are wrapped in <a> tags and <link> holds URL-encoded markup, and dates use Drupal's 'Mon, 09/14/2026 - 09:03' format. fetcher.py repairs all three (_entry_link, _clean_html on titles, _FALLBACK_DATE_FORMATS).

sources.name: FDA Press Releases
sources.notes: Confirmed working 2026-09-14 (20 entries). Agency-wide; the prompt keeps approvals and safety actions relevant to older adults.

sources.name: NIH News Releases
sources.notes: Confirmed working 2026-09-14 (10 entries). Covers all institutes, including NIA, whose own feed no longer exists. Dates use Drupal's 'Mon, 09/14/2026 - 11:00' format, handled by _FALLBACK_DATE_FORMATS in fetcher.py.

sources.name: Social Security Press Releases
sources.notes: UNVERIFIED: same Akamai 'Access Denied' (403) as HHS on 2026-09-14, with default and browser user agents. Left enabled in case Actions runners get through. GovDelivery bulletins (USSSA) also rejected requests.

sources.name: ACL News
sources.notes: NO FEED FOUND (2026-09-14): this path and acl.gov/rss.xml return 404, acl.gov page requests timed out, and GovDelivery (USACL) rejected requests. ACL releases often also appear in HHS news releases. Re-enable if a working feed turns up.

sources.name: FTC Consumer Protection Press Releases
sources.notes: Confirmed working 2026-09-14 (30 entries), but only with a browser user agent; the default agent gets a 403. The consumer-protection feed is used instead of all press releases (feeds/press-release.xml) so antitrust items stay out; it's where scams aimed at older adults show up.

sources.name: CFPB Newsroom
sources.notes: Confirmed working 2026-09-14 (21 entries). Low volume as of mid-2026; newest item was 2026-08-14.

sources.name: World Health Organization News Releases
sources.notes: WHO's RSS feed (who.int/rss-feeds/news-english.xml) stopped updating in February 2026, so this reads the JSON API behind who.int/news instead, via fetcher.py's _fetch_who_source. Confirmed current 2026-09-14. news_types keeps news releases only; add "Statement" to include WHO statements. The API returns titles but no summaries.

sources.name: Alzheimer's Association on PR Newswire
sources.notes: Wire keyword search — source_filter ensures only genuine Alzheimer's Association releases pass.

sources.name: LeadingAge News
sources.notes: Confirmed working. Returns application/rss+xml. Active with multiple posts per week — policy reactions, MedPAC reports, housing, hospice. Sample: 'PAC MA Coalition on OIG Reports' (June 16, 2026), 'MedPAC Releases Report on Alternative Hospice Payments' (June 16, 2026).

sources.name: LeadingAge on PR Newswire
sources.notes: Confirmed PR Newswire org page at prnewswire.com/news/leadingage/. Dedup handles overlap with LeadingAge News feed.

sources.name: AHCA/NCAL on PR Newswire
sources.notes: Confirmed active on PR Newswire 2025-2026.

sources.name: NCOA on PR Newswire
sources.notes: Confirmed dedicated PR Newswire page at prnewswire.com/news/national-council-on-aging/

sources.name: National Alliance for Caregiving on PR Newswire
sources.notes: Confirmed active on PR Newswire 2024-2025.

sources.name: Alliance for Aging Research on PR Newswire
sources.notes: Confirmed active on PR Newswire 2025.

sources.name: KFF Publications
sources.notes: Confirmed working. Returns application/rss+xml. High-relevance content: Medicare, Medicaid, drug pricing, LTC policy, health coverage.

sources.name: Commonwealth Fund
sources.notes: Confirmed from search result. Topic-based feeds also available at commonwealthfund.org/rss-feeds.

sources.name: RAND Research (All Publications)
sources.notes: Confirmed working. Returns valid XML. No aging-specific feed exists — this is all new RAND publications. Claude should filter for aging/LTC/Medicare relevant items. Previous URL (aging.xml) was broken.

sources.name: CareScout / Genworth on Business Wire
sources.notes: Annual Cost of Care Survey released on Business Wire each March. Now published under CareScout brand.

sources.name: HarrisX News & Polling
sources.notes: No RSS/Atom feed exists (checked 2026-09-02: no <link rel=alternate>, no working /feed or /rss path). Scraped directly via fetcher.py's _fetch_html_source — the /news page is a static-rendered Webflow CMS post listing. HarrisX runs general public-opinion polling, not aging-specific, so most items won't be relevant; Claude filters for aging/caregiving/health-policy angles same as the RAND all-publications feed. Confirmed relevant items do appear, e.g. a HousingWire writeup on financial strain from caring for aging parents.
